options.en: Large paintings painted onto a wall or the side of a building
options.zh: 画在墙面上或建筑侧面的大型绘画

options.en: A kind of car
Small paintings on paper that artists carry to show in galleries
options.zh: 画在纸上的小画，画家带去画廊展示

options.en: Songs sung in a choir

explain.en: The book says murals are large paintings painted onto a wall or the side of a building
explain.zh: 书中说，壁画是画在墙面或建筑侧面的大型绘画

q.en: How do potters shape wet clay?
q.zh: 陶艺师如何塑造湿润的黏土？

options.en: By weaving fabric
By blowing air through a tube to harden the clay like glassblowers do
options.zh: 用管子吹气，像玻璃吹制师那样让黏土变硬

options.en: On a pottery wheel that spins very fast
By freezing it

explain.en: Potters put a lump of wet clay on a pottery wheel that spins very fast and shape it with their hands
explain.zh: 陶艺师把一团湿黏土放在快速旋转的陶轮上，用手塑形

q.en: In sculpture, what does the word 'cast' mean?
q.zh: 在雕塑中，「cast」这个词是什么意思？

options.en: To paint a picture of the statue before the metal is poured
options.zh: 在浇入金属之前，先给雕像画一幅画

options.en: To blow glass
To pour hot metal into a mold
options.zh: 把熔融的金属倒入模具

options.en: To weave yarn

explain.en: The glossary defines cast as to pour hot metal into a mold
explain.zh: 词汇表把 cast 定义为把熔融的金属倒入模具

q.en: How do glassblowers make a glass bubble?
q.zh: 玻璃吹制师如何制造出玻璃泡？

options.en: By weaving threads
By hammering cold glass with a small wooden mallet until it is flat
options.zh: 用一把小木槌敲打冷玻璃，直到它变平

options.en: By baking clay
By blowing air through a long, hollow tube called a blowpipe
options.zh: 通过一根叫吹管的空心长管吹气

explain.en: Glassblowers scoop hot glass on a blowpipe and blow air through the tube to make a glass bubble
explain.zh: 玻璃吹制师用吹管舀起热玻璃，并通过管子吹气，制造出玻璃泡

q.en: What is an installation in art?

options.en: Entire rooms or buildings made into works of art
options.zh: 把整个房间或建筑变成艺术作品

options.en: A small painting hung in a corner of a single quiet room
options.zh: 挂在安静房间一角的一幅小画

options.en: A kind of bird
A type of clay

explain.en: The glossary says installations are entire rooms or buildings made into art
explain.zh: 词汇表说，装置是把整个房间或建筑变成的艺术

q.en: Why does the author repeat 'Art is all around us'?
q.zh: 作者为什么反复说「艺术就在我们身边」？

options.en: To describe a car
To encourage readers to notice art everywhere
options.zh: 为了鼓励读者留意处处皆有的艺术

options.en: To sell more paint, because the author works for a paint company
options.zh: 为了卖出更多颜料，因为作者是一家颜料公司的员工

options.en: To teach math

explain.en: The author wants readers to look and find art all around them, in museums, parks, and daily life
explain.zh: 作者希望读者去观察并在身边、博物馆、公园和日常生活中发现艺术

q.en: What do fiber artists use to make their art?
q.zh: 纤维艺术家使用什么来创作？

options.en: Only computers
Only water
Thread, yarns, and fabric pieces, often on a loom
options.zh: 线、纱线和布片，常用织布机编织

options.en: Only metal and stone, since fiber artists never use soft materials
options.zh: 只用金属和石头，因为纤维艺术家从不用柔软材料

explain.en: Fiber artists use thread, yarns, and fabric pieces; weavers loop yarns on a loom to make designs
explain.zh: 纤维艺术家使用线、纱线和布片；织工在织布机上环绕纱线，织出图案

q.en: What is found object art made from?
q.zh: 「现成物艺术（found object art）」是用什么做的？

options.en: Pure gold
Live animals that the artist trains to sit still inside the artwork
options.zh: 艺术家训练它安静地待在作品里的活体动物

options.en: Junk, car parts, old toys, wire, and other scrap materials
options.zh: 垃圾、汽车零件、旧玩具、铁丝和其他废料

options.en: Fresh fruit

explain.en: Some artists make found object art out of junk, car parts, old toys, wire, and other scrap materials
explain.zh: 一些艺术家用垃圾、汽车零件、旧玩具、铁丝和其他废料创作现成物艺术

q.en: Where is some of the oldest art found?
q.zh: 一些最古老的艺术是在哪里发现的？

options.en: Floating in the ocean on pieces of wood washed up from ships
options.zh: 在海上漂浮，附着在从船上冲下来的木块上

options.en: Painted in caves or scratched into rocks
options.zh: 画在洞穴中或刻在岩石上

options.en: Printed in newspapers
Stored on computers

explain.en: The oldest art was painted in caves or scratched into rocks, telling stories of long ago
explain.zh: 最古老的艺术画在洞穴中或刻在岩石上，讲述久远的往事

q.en: What is the author's main message about art?
q.zh: 作者关于艺术的主要观点是什么？

options.en: Art can be fun and is everywhere around you
options.zh: 艺术可以很有趣，而且就在你身边无处不在

options.en: Art must be expensive
Art is only for experts
Art is only in museums, because nothing outside counts as real art
options.zh: 艺术只存在于博物馆，因为博物馆之外都不算真正的艺术

explain.en: The book ends: Art doesn't have to be serious or hard; look, and you will find art all around you
explain.zh: 书的结尾说：艺术不必严肃或困难；只要你去观察，就会发现艺术无处不在

prompt.en: The book says you can make your own art with chalk, clay, or shells. Describe one piece of art you could make from things around you
prompt.zh: 书中说，你可以用粉笔、黏土或贝壳创作自己的艺术。描述一件你可以用身边材料创作的艺术品

en: Name the materials you would use
Describe what your art would look like
zh: 描述你的艺术作品会是什么样子
